variable_semantics.prcp(mm/day): Daily total precipitation depth in millimeters per day; exogenous meteorological forcing.
variable_semantics.srad(W/m2): Incident shortwave radiation flux density in watts per square meter, averaged over the daylight period; exogenous meteorological forcing.
variable_semantics.tmax(C): Daily maximum 2-meter air temperature in degrees Celsius; exogenous meteorological forcing.
variable_semantics.tmin(C): Daily minimum 2-meter air temperature in degrees Celsius; exogenous meteorological forcing.
variable_semantics.vp(Pa): Daily average water vapor pressure in pascals; exogenous meteorological forcing.
variable_semantics.QObs(mm/d): Observed streamflow/discharge normalized by catchment area as runoff depth in millimeters per day; target hydrological response.
variable_semantics.streamflow/QObs(mm/d): Observed streamflow/discharge normalized by catchment area as runoff depth in millimeters per day; target hydrological response.
variable_semantics.tmean(C): Daily mean 2-meter air temperature in degrees Celsius; used in reduced CAMELS-US hydrology benchmark inputs.
variable_semantics.precipitation_us: Daily precipitation for the CAMELS-US component in the reduced cross-train hydrology benchmark input.
variable_semantics.precipitation: Daily precipitation forcing in the reduced combined-CAMELS hydrology benchmark input.
variable_semantics.p_mean: Long-term mean daily precipitation over the catchment, used as a static climate descriptor of water input.
variable_semantics.pet_mean: Long-term mean daily potential evapotranspiration over the catchment, representing atmospheric evaporative demand.
variable_semantics.p_seasonality: Precipitation seasonality and timing index; positive values indicate summer-peaking precipitation, negative values indicate winter-peaking precipitation, and values near zero indicate more uniform precipitation through the year.
variable_semantics.frac_snow: Fraction of precipitation falling as snow, typically estimated from precipitation on days with air temperature below 0 C.
variable_semantics.aridity: Aridity index: ratio of mean potential evapotranspiration to mean precipitation; larger values indicate a drier, more water-limited catchment climate.
variable_semantics.high_prec_freq: Frequency of high-precipitation days, conventionally days with precipitation at least five times the catchment mean daily precipitation.
variable_semantics.high_prec_dur: Average duration of high-precipitation events, counted as consecutive days meeting the high-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.low_prec_freq: Frequency of dry days, conventionally days with precipitation below 1 mm/day.
variable_semantics.low_prec_dur: Average duration of dry periods, counted as consecutive dry days below the low-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.carbonate_rocks_frac: Fraction of catchment geology classified as carbonate rocks.
variable_semantics.huc_02: Two-digit US hydrologic unit code region.
variable_semantics.soil_depth_pelletier: Catchment soil depth estimate. Source/product qualifier: Pelletier.
variable_semantics.soil_depth_statsgo: Catchment soil depth estimate. Source/product qualifier: STATSGO.
variable_semantics.sand_frac: Fraction of soil texture classified as sand.
variable_semantics.silt_frac: Fraction of soil texture classified as silt.
variable_semantics.clay_frac: Fraction of soil texture classified as clay.
variable_semantics.gauge_lat: Latitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.gauge_lon: Longitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.area_gages2: Catchment drainage area from gauge metadata.
variable_semantics.frac_forest: Fraction of catchment area covered by forest.
variable_semantics.lai_max: Maximum leaf area index over the annual cycle.
variable_semantics.lai_diff: Seasonal amplitude of leaf area index.
variable_semantics.gvf_max: Maximum green vegetation fraction over the annual cycle.

variable_semantics.prcp(mm/day): Daily total precipitation depth in millimeters per day; exogenous meteorological forcing.
variable_semantics.tmean(C): Daily mean 2-meter air temperature in degrees Celsius; exogenous meteorological forcing used in reduced CAMELS hydrology benchmark inputs.
variable_semantics.QObs(mm/d): Observed streamflow/discharge normalized by catchment area as runoff depth in millimeters per day; target hydrological response.
variable_semantics.precipitation_us: Daily precipitation for the CAMELS-US component in the reduced cross-train hydrology benchmark input.
variable_semantics.precipitation: Daily precipitation forcing in the reduced combined-CAMELS hydrology benchmark input.
variable_semantics.p_mean: Long-term mean daily precipitation over the catchment, used as a static climate descriptor of water input.
variable_semantics.pet_mean: Long-term mean daily potential evapotranspiration over the catchment, representing atmospheric evaporative demand.
variable_semantics.p_seasonality: Precipitation seasonality and timing index; positive values indicate summer-peaking precipitation, negative values indicate winter-peaking precipitation, and values near zero indicate more uniform precipitation through the year.
variable_semantics.frac_snow: Fraction of precipitation falling as snow, typically estimated from precipitation on days with air temperature below 0 C.
variable_semantics.aridity: Aridity index: ratio of mean potential evapotranspiration to mean precipitation; larger values indicate a drier, more water-limited catchment climate.
variable_semantics.high_prec_freq: Frequency of high-precipitation days, conventionally days with precipitation at least five times the catchment mean daily precipitation.
variable_semantics.high_prec_dur: Average duration of high-precipitation events, counted as consecutive days meeting the high-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.high_prec_timing: Season during which most high-precipitation days occur, e.g. winter, spring, summer, or autumn.
variable_semantics.low_prec_freq: Frequency of dry days, conventionally days with precipitation below 1 mm/day.
variable_semantics.low_prec_dur: Average duration of dry periods, counted as consecutive dry days below the low-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.low_prec_timing: Season during which most dry days occur.
variable_semantics.gauge_lat: Latitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.gauge_lon: Longitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.area: Drainage area of the catchment contributing flow to the gauge or outlet.

variable_semantics.p_mean: Long-term mean daily precipitation over the catchment, used as a static climate descriptor of water input.
variable_semantics.pet_mean: Long-term mean daily potential evapotranspiration over the catchment, representing atmospheric evaporative demand.
variable_semantics.aridity: Aridity index: ratio of mean potential evapotranspiration to mean precipitation; larger values indicate a drier, more water-limited catchment climate.
variable_semantics.frac_snow: Fraction of precipitation falling as snow, typically estimated from precipitation on days with air temperature below 0 C.
variable_semantics.moisture_index: Climate moisture index for the catchment.
variable_semantics.high_prec_freq: Frequency of high-precipitation days, conventionally days with precipitation at least five times the catchment mean daily precipitation.
variable_semantics.high_prec_dur: Average duration of high-precipitation events, counted as consecutive days meeting the high-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.low_prec_freq: Frequency of dry days, conventionally days with precipitation below 1 mm/day.
variable_semantics.low_prec_dur: Average duration of dry periods, counted as consecutive dry days below the low-precipitation threshold.
variable_semantics.gauge_lat: Latitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.gauge_lon: Longitude of the streamflow gauge or basin outlet used to locate the catchment.
variable_semantics.area: Drainage area of the catchment contributing flow to the gauge or outlet.
